notes.title: Behind the Scenes: Cradlemoor
notes.content: [p]Behind the scenes footage of a recent Cradlemoor shoot at the Maltings Taphouse in Newton Abbot, in which the character Mason attemps to hammer a piece of foam to the floor. [/p][p]Thanks to the Maltings for use of the location, and Chris Williams for posting this footage. [/p][p]Warning: contains swearing and implied violence![/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=1Lv2ueb74H4"][/dynamiclink][/p]

notes.title: Cradlemoor features in video for new MA, and progress update
notes.content: [p]We're super-excited that Cradlemoor is featured in the University of Exeter's new promotional video for their MA in Interactive Storytelling Design.[/p][p][dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=pEHpMZSYTfA"][/dynamiclink]Despite rumours to the contrary, Cradlemoor is still very much alive and work is ongoing. We've filmed 95% of the content and are now in the process of putting together the gameplay and scoring the music. New trailer coming soon![/p]
